sourceObservation.method: Actual official checklist UI reads selected Football, Year 2026, then Donruss / Donruss and Panini / Obsidian. Each real Download Full Checklist action generated an a[download] data URI; its percent-encoded UTF-8 payload was decoded without content changes and retained as the original CSV bytes. The export filename and all original SPORT/YEAR/BRAND/PROGRAM cells independently identify the selection.

sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 19,548 rows from the official Panini CSV export are retained, including all original columns, literal card-set parallel names and SEQUENCE values. Empty numbering is not an estimate. Pack odds are absent from this export. Product year does not establish a release date. This export was observed in the official interface on 2026-10-18; that observation is not a release date. Printed card-set identities naming other products are retained. Full product-guide and calendar-release reconciliation remain pending.
